text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Film-photographic original retro-future fjord house interior, coral brick-red curved fireplace, pale oak conversation pit with empty linen seating, panoramic window framing blue-gray water and snowy cliffs, overcast Nordic daylight, tactile fabric and glass, restrained analog grain, understated lived-in warmth with no occupants.
